plans.label: AC!D 2 — Control Section, hall à escalier
plans.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one individual static environment source for CQC's Metal Gear AC!D 2 atlas.
Input references are contact sheets of native gameplay, only the game scenery is relevant. The PSP console border if present, contact-sheet grid, characters, cards, text, icons, highlighted move squares, hit markers, HUD, portraits and black framing are not scenery. Produce ONE contiguous clean environment image, not panels. Follow the exact bounded part of the source noted below; retain observable surface colors, shapes, relative placements and camera. The original art style is vivid cel-shaded Metal Gear AC!D 2 with clean readable shapes; enhance clarity without turning it into a generic photoreal military facility or adding scenic details. No text, HUD, characters, lettering, new logos, extra machinery or made-up rooms. Opaque 16:9 landscape.
Subject: Stage 02 Control Section, the long stair hall seen in the bottom-right reference frame. Use that bottom-right native view as the exact camera/layout anchor and bottom-left/middle-right views for its connections. High elevated oblique camera: a single long narrow straight flight of cream-colored steps connects the two rectangular mint-green tiled circulation levels. Dark green thin handrails and structural edging flank the stair. Dark emerald/teal tall partition walls enclose the levels; their lower portions have pale cream panels lit with warm amber. Muted checkerboard-like pale mint floor motifs, a simple dark rectangular low wall/counter in the near-left level, plain rectangular door/panel on the far wall. Preserve the parallel stair run and offset levels, do not add a grand branching staircase or change to a bathroom. The yellow/purple selection squares and white grid overlays in other frames must not be recreated. Render only the visible hall; no unobserved exterior.
